name: Brass Tyrant

Traits.name: Searing Brass
Traits.text: A creature that touches the brass tyrant or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

Traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
Traits.text: If the brass tyrant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Traits.name: Siege Monster
Traits.text: The brass tyrant deals double damage to objects and structures.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The brass tyrant makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Slag Pour.

Actions.name: Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 10 ft. 20 (4d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) Fire damage.

Actions.name: Molten Spray (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 72 (16d8) Fire damage. *Success:* Half damage only.

Actions.name: Slag Pour
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. *Failure:* 35 (10d6) Fire damage, and the target has the Prone condition.
Actions.clause: The brass tyrant wades through a forge-gate or a rebel barricade, and the molten ruin it wrenches loose sluices ahead of
Actions.expressedQuote: the target has the Prone condition

Legendary Actions.name: Legendary Action Uses: 3
Legendary Actions.text: Immediately after another creature's turn, the brass tyrant can expend a use to take one of the following actions. It regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

Legendary Actions.name: Crushing Advance
Legendary Actions.text: The brass tyrant moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Slam attack.

Legendary Actions.name: Gate Breaker
Legendary Actions.text: The brass tyrant moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. During this movement, it can move through Large or smaller objects and structures, destroying them.

Legendary Actions.name: Molten Quake
Legendary Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 19, each creature within 10 feet of the brass tyrant. *Failure:* The target has the Prone condition.

lore: Poured in the first furnace of a city that forges weapons for a hundred wars, the Brass Tyrant was made to rule that city and has never once been cooled.

generation.userConcept: a tyrant of burning brass who rules a city of forges
generation.cite: composition after Tarrasque (CR 30) — the juggernaut shapes under a legendary menu

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
monsterDescription: a tyrant of burning brass who rules a city of forges
